subject: ophthalmology
title: Glaucoma Overview and Optic Nerve Head

steps.tx: **Glaucoma** is progressive optic neuropathy with characteristic disc excavation and visual field loss, intraocular pressure main modifiable risk though damage occurs at normal pressures and high pressure without damage exists. Retinal ganglion axon loss at lamina cribrosa produces cupping and nerve fibre defects. It is disease of nerve, pressure being risk and treatment lever, definition examinations test first.
steps.say: Progressive neuropathy together gives glaucoma definition beyond pressure number at examinations for students reliably each time. Axon loss gives cupping mechanism additionally. Pressure gives modifiable lever status.

steps.tx: **Optic nerve head** cupping enlarges cup disc ratio vertically, neuroretinal rim thinning violating the inferior superior nasal temporal thickness order early in glaucoma. Rim notching, disc haemorrhage and nerve fibre wedge defects mark progression at disc examination. Asymmetry between eyes beyond small limits therefore triggers glaucoma workup even at normal pressures.
steps.say: Rim thinning together gives early glaucoma disc evidence at fundus examination in screening clinics for adults. Haemorrhage gives progression marking additionally. Asymmetry gives workup trigger value.

steps.tx: **ISNT rule** states healthy rim thickest inferior, then superior, nasal, temporal thinnest, glaucoma violating order earliest inferiorly and superiorly. Rule breaking rim therefore suspects glaucoma before field loss in disc screening. Large physiological cups in large discs need size correction before ratio alarm in myopic screening populations.
steps.say: Rim order together gives screening rule in disc assessment at glaucoma clinics for adults with large cups. Violation gives early suspicion additionally. Disc size gives ratio context.

steps.tx: Open versus angle closure classification by gonioscopy mechanism decides laser and surgery families in following batches, outflow anatomy from earlier lessons applied. Primary open angle insidious bilateral, angle closure pupillary block acute or chronic by anatomy. **Gonioscopy mandatory** in every new glaucoma because pressure alone never classifies mechanism.
steps.say: Gonioscopy together gives mechanism classification in every new glaucoma at diagnosis clinics for adults without exception. Pressure gives insufficient classification additionally. Anatomy gives family direction.

steps.tx: **Target pressure** individualises by baseline damage, progression rate, life expectancy and pressure level at damage, lower targets for advanced or progressing disease. Single normal range number therefore never manages glaucoma patient longitudinally. Progression despite target resets target lower in stepwise chronic care.
steps.say: Individual target together gives longitudinal glaucoma management beyond normal range at follow up clinics for adults over years. Progression gives resetting rule additionally. Damage gives starting severity.

steps.tx: Visual field defects respect horizontal midline and nerve fibre bundles: arcuate scotomas, nasal steps and paracentral loss early, tunnel vision late with central island. Field pattern therefore localises to nerve fibre layer against neurological defects respecting vertical midline. **Horizontal respect** is glaucoma field signature examinations contrast with chiasmal vertical respect.
steps.say: Horizontal respect together gives glaucoma field signature against neurological patterns at perimetry review in clinics for adults. Arcuate shape gives bundle logic additionally. Vertical gives chiasmal contrast.

steps.tx: Ocular hypertension without damage observes or treats by risk profile, normal tension glaucoma with damage at normal pressures treats pressure lower still proving pressure relative concept. Both challenge pressure only definitions in opposite directions at screening. **Damage decides** glaucoma label, pressure decides intensity in both paradoxes.
steps.say: Damage decision together gives glaucoma labelling in pressure paradoxes at screening clinics for adults with borderline numbers. Intensity gives pressure role additionally. Observation gives hypertension option.

steps.tx: Anchors overview: nerve disease, rim order violated, fields respect horizontal and targets individualise by damage. Gonioscopy classifies mechanism before drops family chosen in next batches. **Cupping plus field** diagnoses, pressure number alone never does in glaucoma. Screening programmes therefore refer by disc and field suspicion without waiting for pressure thresholds.
steps.say: Nerve pattern together gives glaucoma diagnosis beyond pressure at examinations for students reliably in screening and clinic. Gonioscopy gives mechanism additionally. Target gives longitudinal individualisation.

cards.b: Progressive optic neuropathy with cupping and fibre field loss; pressure is modifiable risk, not definition.
Rim thickest inferior then superior nasal temporal; violation suspects glaucoma early.
Individualised by damage and progression; progressing disease resets target lower.
